title: Record the FFT word parameter bounds
body:
## Summary
- For every width from 2 through 65536 and at width 1000000, the digit ring sits between twice and four times the digit count, and every product coefficient has one spare leading bit.
- The direct screen is 799/500, above one. The absorbed power 9981/10000 lies under the Fourier power by 17619697/100000000000.
- Partial, no new kappa. This records these bounds. It does not run the word multiplier.
